sloka: यदा च शस्त्रं नारेभे न व्यकर्षच्छरासनम् ।नास्य प्रत्यकरोद्वीर्यं विक्लेवेनान्तरात्मना ।। ६.१०५.२८ ।।
transliteration: yadā ca śastraṁ nārebhe na vyakarṣaccharāsanam ।nāsya pratyakarodvīryaṁ viklevenāntarātmanā ।। 6.105.28 ।।

translations.english: Being confused mentally, Ravana did not start his arrows, nor stretch his bow, nor was able to use missiles and was not able to oppose Rama's valour.
